verdict.rationale: The evidence shows official getting-started pieces with exact commands: CLI install steps such as `brew update && brew install azure-cli`, plus Cloud Shell and Docker options. It also shows a free account and declarative Bicep/ARM/Terraform deployment docs, and a marketing claim that you can 'quickly create powerful cloud apps.' But no official quickstart in the pack walks from zero to a running service with the deploy commands shown, and nothing evidences the under-an-hour time. Missing for 10: an end-to-end official deploy quickstart with exact commands, evidence of time-to-first-deploy under an hour, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a smooth first deploy.
